specs.title: US-01.1 admin creation form captures name, email, role and institutional ID

annotations.description: Form shows Full name, Email, Institutional ID and a Role selector offering Student / Faculty / Admin.

specs.title: US-01.2 a secure temporary password is displayed on screen

annotations.description: Confirmation screen shows a 12-character password mixing upper/lower case, digits and symbols, with a warning that it is shown only once.

specs.title: US-01.3 the new record is saved with is_temporary_password = true

annotations.description: User list marks the account "Temp password"; a direct database query returns is_temporary_password = 1.

specs.title: US-01.4 duplicate institutional ID or email is rejected with 409

annotations.description: Duplicate email -> HTTP 409 DUPLICATE_EMAIL; duplicate ID -> HTTP 409 DUPLICATE_INSTITUTIONAL_ID; the form shows the error next to the field.

specs.title: US-02.1 temporary credentials redirect to the password reset view

annotations.description: After signing in with the temporary password the user lands on "Set a new password"; navigating to /catalog bounces back to it.

specs.title: US-02.2 password complexity rules are enforced

annotations.description: "abc" meets 1 of 5 rules, so the button stays disabled; the server independently rejects it with 400 WEAK_PASSWORD and lists 4 unmet rules.

specs.title: US-02.3 the password is stored as a bcrypt hash with work factor 12

annotations.description: Database value begins "$2b$12$" (bcrypt, cost 12) and is 60 characters; the plain password is not stored.

specs.title: US-02.4 the temporary flag is cleared and the user reaches their dashboard

annotations.description: After the reset the student dashboard is shown; the database flag is 0 and the API reports must_change_password = false.

specs.title: US-03.1 profile shows contact information and the assigned institutional ID

annotations.description: Profile lists institutional ID UAT0001, institutional email and the editable contact fields.

specs.title: US-03.2 phone, emergency contact and personal email can be edited and saved

annotations.description: Saved with a confirmation toast; after a full page reload all three values are still there.

specs.title: US-03.3 phone and email formats are validated before saving

annotations.description: Invalid phone and email show inline errors and nothing is saved; the server also answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

specs.title: US-03.4 institutional ID and role cannot be modified by a non-admin

annotations.description: The UI shows these fields as locked text. A forged API request is refused with 403 READ_ONLY_FIELD and the role / ID are unchanged.

specs.title: US-04.1 admin can search users and toggle Active / Inactive

annotations.description: Searching by email narrows the list to one user whose Active switch is on.

specs.title: US-04.2 deactivating an account revokes its live session immediately

annotations.description: A student signed in elsewhere was sent to the sign-in page with "account deactivated" on their very next request, and signing in again returns 403.

specs.title: US-04.3 the status change is written to the administrative audit log

annotations.description: Audit log row: "User status changed" by ADM001 for PES1UG24CS009, old = Active, new = Inactive, with a timestamp.

specs.title: US-05.1 admin registers a course offering with a seat capacity

annotations.description: Course UAT101 created with capacity 3 and assigned faculty FAC050; the list shows 0 / 3 seats filled.

specs.title: US-05.2 weighted components can be defined (Assignments, Exams, Projects)

annotations.description: Saved rubric has three components in the categories Assignments, Exams and Projects.

specs.title: US-05.3 weights are normalised to exactly 100.0% on save

annotations.description: Raw weights 1 : 1 : 1 were saved as 33.34 + 33.33 + 33.33 = 100.00 exactly (the extra cent goes to the largest remainder).

specs.title: US-06.1 the catalog shows open sections with real-time seat capacity

annotations.description: UAT101 card shows "3 of 3 seats open"; the header shows this student is enrolled in 4 of 6 courses.

specs.title: US-06.2 a student can enroll in an available section

annotations.description: Enrollment succeeded with a confirmation toast and the card now shows an "Enrolled" badge.

specs.title: US-06.3 enrolling beyond 6 courses is blocked with an error

annotations.description: A student already on 6 courses sees the error "You can enroll in at most 6 courses per term"; a direct API call returns 409 ENROLLMENT_LIMIT_REACHED.

specs.title: US-06.4 a confirmed enrollment decrements the available seats immediately

annotations.description: After the enrollment the section shows "2 of 3 seats open" and the student counter moved from 4 / 6 to 5 / 6.

specs.title: US-07.1 admin assigns date, time slot and room to a course offering

annotations.description: Published UAT101 for 2026-10-29 10:00-11:00 in room UAT-R1; it appears in the scheduled-sessions table.

specs.title: US-07.2 student and faculty dashboards show weekly calendars with the sessions

annotations.description: The enrolled student sees UAT101 (room UAT-R1) in the dashboard "This week" card and in the weekly calendar page; the assigned faculty member sees it on their dashboard.

specs.title: US-07.3 faculty can only see rosters of their own sections

annotations.description: "My sections" lists exactly the 3 sections assigned to faculty001; the roster of a section taught by someone else returns 403 NOT_ASSIGNED with no student data.

specs.title: US-08.1 the roster lists the enrolled students of the selected section

annotations.description: The roll-call opened from the dashboard widget lists 50 enrolled students with their institutional IDs.

specs.title: US-08.2 faculty can toggle Present / Absent for each student

annotations.description: Rows 2 and 5 were switched to Absent (highlighted red); the others remain Present.

specs.title: US-08.3 Save persists the records and shows a confirmation

annotations.description: Toast "Attendance recorded for N students"; after a full reload the two Absent marks are still stored.

specs.title: US-08.4 re-editing is blocked once the session started more than 48 hours ago

annotations.description: A frozen session opens read-only with a banner, the toggles are disabled and there is no Save button; bypassing the UI with a direct API call returns 403 ATTENDANCE_FROZEN.

specs.title: US-09.1 admin can edit attendance after the 48-hour freeze

annotations.description: A frozen session (faculty cannot edit) was corrected by the admin: first student Present -> Absent.

specs.title: US-09.2 a justification reason is mandatory

annotations.description: Applying without a reason is refused in the UI ("a justification of at least 5 characters is required") and by the API (400); nothing was changed.

specs.title: US-09.3 every override creates an immutable audit entry (admin, old value, new value, timestamp)

annotations.description: Entry shows admin ADM001, old value "Present", new value "Absent", the reason and a timestamp. There is no edit or delete endpoint (PUT/PATCH/DELETE -> 404/405) and the ORM rejects updates to audit rows.

specs.title: US-10.1 the student dashboard shows attendance percentage per enrolled course

annotations.description: The Attendance card lists 5 enrolled courses; the 4 that have held sessions each show a percentage and a progress bar (the course joined moments ago has no session yet and shows 0 attended / 0 missed / 0 held).

specs.title: US-10.2 the course view breaks down sessions held, attended and missed

annotations.description: CS102: 12 sessions held = 6 attended + 6 missed, with a per-session table.

specs.title: US-10.3 courses below 75% attendance are visually flagged

annotations.description: Only CS102 (below 75%) carries the red "Below 75%" badge, plus a page-level warning; the other courses are not flagged.

specs.title: US-11.1 the grade sheet renders the rubric components for every enrolled student

annotations.description: CS103 sheet: one column per rubric component (Assignments 10%, Capstone Project 40%, Final Exam 50%) for each of the enrolled students.

specs.title: US-11.2 partial or complete scores can be saved in Draft state

annotations.description: One student saved with a single score, another with all three; after a reload both persist and show state "Draft".

specs.title: US-11.3 students cannot see marks while the grade is in Draft

annotations.description: student001 has Draft marks in CS103 but sees only "Pending - marks will appear here once published"; no numbers are shown.

specs.title: US-12.1 submitting calculates the weighted total and moves to Submitted

annotations.description: 80 / 90 / 70 with weights 10 / 40 / 50 gives a weighted total of 79.00 (8 + 36 + 35); the row moved to "Submitted" and its inputs are locked.

specs.title: US-12.2 admin can batch-publish courses in the Submitted state

annotations.description: The publication queue listed CS103 (and the other submitted course); the batch action published it and it left the queue.

specs.title: US-12.3 published grades become visible to the student immediately

annotations.description: Immediately after publication student001 sees CS103 as Published with total 79.00 and letter C.

specs.title: US-13.1 a dispute button appears next to published grades

annotations.description: The Dispute button sits in the CS103 row next to the published grade.

specs.title: US-13.2 a written explanation is required before filing

annotations.description: Submitting with an empty explanation shows "Please explain your request in at least 10 characters" and the grade stays Published.

specs.title: US-13.3 filing the dispute moves the grade to Under Review

annotations.description: With an explanation the request is filed; CS103 shows "Under Review" and the Dispute button disappears.

specs.title: US-13.4 faculty is notified, re-evaluates and re-publishes the grade

annotations.description: Faculty saw the red notification badge, re-scored the first component (80 -> 95) and re-published. The student sees Published, total 79.00 -> 80.50 (letter B), the faculty note, and the "Regrade used" badge: a second dispute is no longer possible.

specs.title: US-14.1 the student dashboard shows a credit-weighted term GPA

annotations.description: Displayed GPA 9.14 / 10 equals sum(grade points x credits) / sum(credits) = 9.14 over 7 credits of published grades (A=10, B=8, C=6, D=4, F=0).

specs.title: US-14.2 faculty see A-F grade distribution charts per section

annotations.description: Three sections, each with an A / B / C / D / F histogram plus mean, median, graded count and attendance rate.

specs.title: US-14.3 analytics queries execute in under 800 ms

annotations.description: Server-side query time reported on screen: student GPA 1.8 ms, faculty analytics 6.2 ms (limit 800 ms); the load test measured p95 = 30 ms at 500 sessions.

specs.title: US-15.1 a single click exports attendance and grade metrics to CSV

annotations.description: One click downloaded system-metrics-20261028-172743.csv with 51 course rows plus a TOTAL row, containing attendance rates and grade-state counts.

specs.title: US-15.2 TLS 1.3, HTTP-only 48-hour JWT sessions and parameterised queries are enforced

annotations.description:
Handshake with a TLS 1.2-only client is refused (C0ACA61FFC7A0000:error:0A00042E:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert protocol version:../deps/openssl/openssl/ssl/record/rec_layer_s3.c:918:SSL alert number 70
); TLS 1.3 connects (TLSv1.3). Over HTTPS the login cookie is HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite=Lax with a 48 h lifetime, HSTS is sent, and the token is not in the response body. A SQL-injection payload in a search returns 0 rows and the users table is intact (parameterised ORM queries).

specs.title: US-15.3 200 simultaneous submissions complete without a database deadlock

annotations.description: Evidence from the k6 run of 2026-10-28T17:13:41.217Z: 200 simultaneous attendance + grade submissions across 12 server processes -> 200 accepted, 0 failed, 0 HTTP errors (also covered by the PyTest concurrency test).

specs.title: EX-1 attack the grade lifecycle as a student

annotations.description: Edit marks / publish / submit / self-resolve / list users all returned 403; a second dispute returned 409 ALREADY_DISPUTED; another student's enrollment returned 404; /grades/mine exposes only the caller's data. No weakness found.

specs.title: EX-2 try to see or change another faculty member's sections

annotations.description: Grade sheet, save marks, submit and roster of a foreign section all returned 403; the dispute list only contains the faculty member's own courses (CS103, CS101). No weakness found.

specs.title: EX-3 keyboard-only operation and a 375 px screen

annotations.description: Signed in and reached the content using only the keyboard (skip link works: focus moved into main = true); at 375 px four pages have no horizontal scroll and the drawer opens from the keyboard. A full screen-reader pass is not automated and remains for the human session.

specs.title: EX-4 hostile input in the text fields

annotations.description: Seven hostile strings (script tags, an event-handler image, SQL, 5,000 characters, 60 emoji, a template expression, a negative number) were submitted through the account form, the user search and the course form: no JavaScript dialog, no uncaught page error, no HTTP 5xx. The stored name for the <script> payload is "alert(1)" (markup stripped).

specs.title: EX-5 two sessions edit the same attendance sheet at once

annotations.description: Two browser sessions saved the same roll-call within the same instant (conflicting values for one student): both saves succeeded, the roster has 50 unique rows, no HTTP 5xx; the last write wins (3 students absent in the final state).
